name: The Serpent Prince
source:
Exchanged for a debt, Momiji must attempt to uncover the mystery surrounding his new husband's desire for revenge against Momiji's own family.

[From [url=https://artsdahl.itch.io/the-serpent-prince]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Momiji被当作偿债的代价交了出去。他必须设法揭开谜团，弄清新婚丈夫为何一心向自己的家族复仇。

[摘自[url=https://artsdahl.itch.io/the-serpent-prince]itch.io[/url]]
